caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate stage set designed to resemble an opulent interior with classical architectural features. Dominating the composition are large peach-colored curtains with blue-green fringes and gold trim that frame the top and sides of the scene. In the foreground, two statues—each resembling a human figure supporting a decorative urn—stand on ornate gold and white pedestals at either side. Behind these statues, richly decorated columns with gold capitals and deep red or purple shafts support a heavy entablature. An expansive archway in the center, adorned with sculpted decorative motifs and flanked by female statues, opens into a background space featuring a curving, golden staircase on the right. The staircase is highlighted by a banister with ornamental gold details and leads upwards toward a landing with archways and a balustrade in lighter gold and cream tones. Both flanks near the base of the stairs hold potted plants or arrangements of colorful flowers. The background beyond the stairs displays additional arches, pillars, and a diffuse blue and lavender sky or wall, contributing to the impression of depth and grandeur. The overall color palette includes peach, blue-green, gold, cream, lavender, and touches of red and purple, giving the scene a vibrant and decorative appearance.
title: Stage Set
